summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_INCOMPLETE. inherited_contract.all_20_old_clauses_retained: The original RAW485 fourteen and RAW487 six complete clauses remain verbatim in their bound files. This incomplete descendant neither reparses nor changes them.

old_operators.SING: Execute successive note/rest events of the performer's own assigned part on that performer's local clock. Same operator for C06 leader and C09 lower pes; the argument-owned part changes the trace.
old_operators.REPEAT: After the complete current part, restart that part from its beginning on the same voice clock, with no added delay or new singer. Same operator for following rota singers in C02 and the two pes in C03.
old_operators.TOGETHER: Assert onset equality for the subject set; preserve all individual part identities and local clock trajectories.
old_operators.ENTER: Single inactive-to-active transition of a rota singer at its first prescribed onset. A later part repeat is not a second ENTER.
old_operators.WHEN: Create an event dependency using a resolved owner and cue, not a free equal-time spacing or textual adjacency relation.
old_operators.PAUSE: A rest is a duration-carrying event with its written owner/location. Internal versus terminal is topological, not equal-half duration.
old_operators.NO_END_PAUSE: Forbid an added terminal rest on P2; do not delete P2's already written internal rest.

newer_operators.INITIAL_ONSET: A TIME reference T0 belonging to the explicitly shared performance.
newer_operators.CO_ONSET(A,B): Require every first-start event in nonempty typed sets A and B to have equal time; no identity fusion or later phase reset.
newer_operators.BEGIN_BOTH_PES(pair): Return the two first StartPart event terms for the fixed pair [U,L], preserving their P1/P2 assignments.
newer_operators.START_NEXT_PES(pair,i): For 0<=i<2 return (StartPart(pair[i]),i+1); at i=2 a further call is undefined. The written two calls are not hardcoded to two unrelated names.
newer_operators.PRESERVE_OWN_CYCLE(v): Use assigned(v)'s complete ordered note/rest sequence and retained branch durations. The onset established for v determines later cycle boundaries. Other singers' ENTER events do not modify that cycle or clock.
newer_operators.IMMEDIATE_CYCLE_RESTART(v): At completion of assigned(v), restart it on v's existing clock without an added terminal rest, under the parent's unchanged need condition.
newer_operators.DISTINCT_GROUPS(A,B): Require A intersect B to be empty; preserve both already bound performer groups.
newer_operators.RESTATE: Reassert constraints on the same previously identified event term. It does not run an event again.
newer_operators.IDENTICAL_ROLE(a,b): Assert identity of same-sort HUMAN_PERFORMER referents, not similarity of names or parts.
newer_operators.WITHOUT_TERMINAL_REST(part): Require that the last event in the complete assigned written cycle is not REST. Do not delete, move or relabel any source event. P2 satisfies the source condition; an assigned cycle ending in REST does not.

no_weakening: ENTER still denotes a single first inactive-to-active transition of a rota singer; it cannot be applied to a pes performer.
COMPANIONS remains the rota-performer group, including its leader; it is not a generic word for any fellow performer.
UPPER_PES remains U/P1 and PES remains the distinct pair [U,L] assigned P1/P2.
OTHERS_SILENT still applies to all not-yet-entered rota singers, not merely an arbitrary silent subset.
LEADER remains R0 and no later clause installs another leader.
additional_fixed_meanings: Every qokeedy here is INITIAL_ONSET T0, never a new performance time per occurrence.
Every qokeey is the SOLE_STARTER role. It cannot be whichever singer the nearest clause needs.
Every dain restates that same starter's first entry.
Every qokedy retains CO_ONSET over first-start event sets. It does not become arbitrary equality, actor identity or later-cycle synchronization.
ENTER still applies only to a rota singer's first inactive-to-active transition; pes start by separate part-start operations.

specific_binding_gaps.raw: olchedy lchedy qokeey okeeedy okain chedy
specific_binding_gaps.known: WRITTEN_PAUSE FOLLOWER SOLE_STARTER UNKNOWN LOWER_PES ENTER
specific_binding_gaps.gap: Directly taking adjacent LOWER_PES as ENTER actor violates the fixed rota-only domain. SOLE_STARTER and FOLLOWER are also actually written, so there are real alternative actor sources; no existing full production chooses between them across unknown okeeedy and the lower-pes noun.
specific_binding_gaps.different_consequences: ENTER(SoleStarter) belongs to T0. An explicitly selected follower's first entry is after its predecessor reaches X. Starting L/P2 is a different operation and cannot be renamed ENTER. FOLLOWER additionally needs a declared selector/quantifier, not an invented person.
specific_binding_gaps.not_a_refutation: Adjacency alone does not force LOWER_PES to be the actor. A new typed construction might retain it as a separate participant argument. Such a construction and the remaining line are not supplied here.

specific_binding_gaps.gap: The visible outer arguments denote human roles; fixed CO_ONSET receives first-event sets. A new surface reduction could map them to ENTER(SoleStarter) and FIRST_PART_START(L), but that reduction must be declared rather than changing old lexical types.
specific_binding_gaps.positive_local_option: One prospective three-terminal production would reduce this exact span to CO_ONSET({ENTER(SoleStarter)},{FIRST_PART_START(L)}). It preserves all three word denotations and differs from the rejected pes-ENTER reading. This is a documented possible constructor, not an adopted whole-paragraph grammar or executed test.
specific_binding_gaps.strongest_prior_countercase: RAW487 D04 already maps a written bare LEADER to ENTER(LEADER) inside its fully specified six-terminal production. Therefore surface role nouns are not in themselves a semantic contradiction, and literal ENTER need not accompany every event argument. That old construction is retained; it does not by itself parse this different three-terminal span.

specific_binding_gaps.gap: The third CO_ONSET context begins with TIME T0 rather than the human role in G2. T0 cannot itself become a first-event set. A temporal-adjunct reading may be possible, but its event-set operands and attachment remain unspecified across the complete line. The unknown qoteedy/qod cannot silently stand for an entire desired schedule.
specific_binding_gaps.different_consequences: A declaration about first events at T0 is distinct from repeated cycle boundaries or later follower starts. Keeping CO_ONSET first-event-only does not express continuing-cycle synchronization.
specific_binding_gaps.missing_joint_binding: All three occurrences of the same operator need one fixed denotation with explicitly supplied differently typed surrounding grammar. No occurrence-specific operator rewrite or hidden Time-to-EventSet coercion is permitted.

specific_binding_gaps.known: Four exact dain occurrences all RESTATE_SAME_STARTER; .13 has or dain shey = AND_NEXT RESTATE_SAME_STARTER SING.
specific_binding_gaps.gap: A continuing-performance account cannot make dain a general restatement of whichever follower is current. The parent meaning names the one starter's first entry. The .13 entry-rule extension, starter restatement and SING need separate declared scope and owner binding; SING is not ENTER.
specific_binding_gaps.performance_reference: The block lacks old techedy=ROTA and qokylddy=explicit next-ROTA performance link. Their absence proves no impossibility, but a new crossleaf same-performance or fresh-performance binding must be written down. No unmarked reset of T0 or roster is licensed.

substantive_extension_attempt.idea_considered: An account of ongoing cycles after all selected rota voices have joined, referring back to initial phases and comparing continuing pes/rota behavior.
substantive_extension_attempt.why_not_filled: The old T0, sole-starter, first-ENTER and first-CO_ONSET meanings remain startup references even in such a later account. They cannot supply changing cycle-origin or later-restart operators. A meaningful retrospective phase account might be possible with explicit new operators, but none of the207 missing values and required scope links is currently fixed. Rather than make one unknown word encode every missing sentence, this card preserves the exact unresolved sites.
substantive_extension_attempt.claim_ceiling: This is a concrete unfinished extension under a selected full target, not a proof that music, the fixed lexicon, or that source story is false.
